==Red Ajah?==

I'm curious to know where in the books it says that Marith is a Red sister? I've looked in tGH and aCoS as per the references on her page, and neither mentions her Ajah. I'm not about to go looking through all the books to find out, so if someone knows off the top of their head, please reply with a book and chapter reference ;) Thanks.
<br>[[User:Daea|Daea]] 05:22, January 2, 2011 (UTC)
:Actually, she is not Red Ajah. Of the thirty-nine sisters sent to kidnap Rand, only five were Red and all of those are accounted for. Of the remaining Aes Sedai, they were both Green and White. I've update the page to reflect this.
